BossNodePath.maps_to: none -- headless sim has no map-node rendering
BossNodePath.rationale: BossNodePath is a map-node icon asset path; the sim's map layer (actmap.py) has no node-rendering concept, only structural point/edge data.

BossNodeSpineResource.maps_to: none -- headless sim has no map-node rendering
BossNodeSpineResource.rationale: Same rationale as BossNodePath -- purely a Spine skeleton resource lookup for map-node rendering.

HasCustomBackground.maps_to: none -- headless sim has no background/rendering layer
HasCustomBackground.rationale: VantomBoss.HasCustomBackground => true is a pure presentation switch; the sim has no background/asset concept at all.

CustomBgm.maps_to: none -- headless sim has no audio layer
CustomBgm.rationale: VantomBoss.CustomBgm names an FMOD event path; the sim has no audio layer at all.

AllPossibleMonsters.maps_to: none -- the sim has no per-encounter monster-preview member

GetCameraScaling.maps_to: none -- headless sim has no camera/rendering layer
GetCameraScaling.rationale: VantomBoss.GetCameraScaling => 0.9f is a pure presentation value; the sim never renders combat.

GetCameraOffset.maps_to: none -- headless sim has no camera/rendering layer
GetCameraOffset.rationale: VantomBoss.GetCameraOffset => Vector2.Down * 50f is a pure presentation value; same rationale as GetCameraScaling.

GenerateMonsters.note: C# GenerateMonsters is a single-element list [(Vantom, null)], zero draws; VantomBoss also has no Slots override (default empty), so the null slot is doubly unremarkable. The sim's plain Encounter with one monster class, no create_monsters override, no slots kwarg matches exactly.

ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.maps_to: structural: Encounter is never registered with HookSystem

Tags.note: No Tags override in C# (default empty).

MinGoldReward.note: No override in C#; base ladder for RoomType.Boss is 100. Poverty multiplier out of scope, not applied in roll_gold_reward.
